Change UNVERIFIED_SERVERS only to the exact recomputed set and report the diff with reasons.

Negative controls required: synthetic tmp_path tests for hyphen-truncation tool, wildcard of an unknown server, wildcard of a known server (no violation), '/mcp unknownserver tool', '/mcp conport bad_tool', and ./scripts missing.
